propertySets.name: Pset_FanOccurrence
propertySets.definition: Fan occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFan.

properties.name: DischargeType
properties.definition:
Defines the type of connection at the fan discharge.Duct: Discharge into ductwork.
Screen: Discharge into screen outlet.
Louver: Discharge into a louver.
Damper: Discharge into a damper.

properties.name: ApplicationOfFan
properties.definition:
The functional application of the fan.SupplyAir: Supply air fan.
ReturnAir: Return air fan.
ExhaustAir: Exhaust air fan.
Other: Other type of application not defined above.

properties.name: CoilPosition
properties.definition:
Defines the relationship between a fan and a coil.DrawThrough: Fan located downstream of the coil.
BlowThrough: Fan located upstream of the coil.

properties.name: MotorPosition
properties.definition:
Defines the location of the motor relative to the air stream.InAirStream: Fan motor is in the air stream.
OutOfAirStream: Fan motor is out of the air stream.

properties.name: FanMountingType
properties.definition: Defines the method of mounting the fan in the building.

properties.name: FractionOfMotorHeatToAirStream
properties.definition: Fraction of the motor heat released into the fluid flow.

properties.name: ImpellerDiameter
properties.definition: Diameter of object - used to scale performance of geometrically similar objects.

propertySets.name: Pset_FanPHistory
propertySets.definition: Fan performance history attributes.IFC2X2 CHANGE Sound attribute deleted in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum: Use IfcSoundProperties instead.

properties.name: FanRotationSpeed
properties.definition: Fan rotation speed.

properties.name: WheelTipSpeed
properties.definition: Fan blade tip speed, typically defined as the linear speed of the tip of the fan blade furthest from the shaft.

properties.name: FanEfficiency
properties.definition: Fan mechanical efficiency.

properties.name: OverallEfficiency
properties.definition: Total efficiency of object.

properties.name: FanPowerRate
properties.definition: Fan power consumption.

properties.name: ShaftPowerRate
properties.definition: Fan shaft power.

properties.name: DischargeVelocity
properties.definition: The speed at which air discharges from the fan through the fan housing discharge opening.

properties.name: DischargePressureLoss
properties.definition: Fan discharge pressure loss associated with the discharge arrangement.

properties.name: DrivePowerLoss
properties.definition: Fan drive power losses associated with the type of connection between the motor and the fan wheel.

properties.name: Reference
properties.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), Also referred to as "construction type". It should be provided as an alternative to the name of the "object type", if the software does not support object types and no classification reference to a recognized classification system used.IFC4.3.0.0 DEPRECATION  The Reference property is deprecated and shall no longer be used, use attribute Name on the relating type instead.

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: MotorDriveType
properties.definition:
Motor drive type:
DIRECTDRIVE: Direct drive.
BELTDRIVE: Belt drive.
COUPLING: Coupling.
OTHER: Other type of motor drive.
UNKNOWN: Unknown motor drive type.

properties.name: CapacityControlType
properties.definition:
InletVane: Control by adjusting inlet vane.
VariableSpeedDrive: Control by variable speed drive.
BladePitchAngle: Control by adjusting blade pitch angle.
TwoSpeed: Control by switch between high and low speed.
DischargeDamper: Control by modulating discharge damper.

properties.name: OperationTemperatureRange
properties.definition: Allowable operation ambient air temperature range.

properties.name: NominalAirFlowRate
properties.definition: Nominal air flow rate.

properties.name: NominalTotalPressure
properties.definition: Nominal total pressure rise across the fan.

properties.name: NominalStaticPressure
properties.definition: The static pressure within the air stream that the fan must overcome to insure designed circulation of air.

properties.name: NominalRotationSpeed
properties.definition:
Rotational speed of the object under nominal conditions.

Nominal fan wheel speed.

properties.name: NominalPowerRate
properties.definition: Nominal fan power rate.

properties.name: OperationalCriteria
properties.definition: Time of operation at maximum operational ambient air temperature.

properties.name: PressureCurve
properties.definition: Pressure rise = f (flow rate).

properties.name: EfficiencyCurve
properties.definition: Fan efficiency =f (flow rate).

propertySets.name: Qto_FanBaseQuantities
propertySets.definition: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all types of fans.
